title: RTPS: Fix PID_TYPE_OBJECT dissection for non-RTI vendors
description:
PID_TYPE_OBJECT (0x0072) is a standard RTPS parameter defined in the
OMG XTypes specification, but its dissection handler was registered only
in the RTI DDS vendor-specific parameter sequence, making it unreachable
for other vendors such as Twin Oaks CoreDX.

Move the handler to dissect_parameter_sequence_v2 so it is processed for
all RTPS implementations, and add PID_TYPE_OBJECT to parameter_id_v2_vals.

Add WS_ROUNDUP_4(offset) after every check_offset_addition() call in the
type object dissection path. This handles the OMG-standard wire format
where a member's length field reflects only the data size and does not
include trailing alignment padding, as opposed to the RTI legacy format
where padding is included in the length. WS_ROUNDUP_4 is a no-op when
the offset is already 4-byte aligned, so RTI captures are unaffected.

AI-Assisted: yes (GitHub Copilot, Claude)
